extracted.name: Honey Mustard Dipping Sauce
extracted.description: A creamy dipping sauce with just the right notes of sweet and tang, universally great for "everything!". Use it as a dipping sauce - think crunchy chicken tenders, fish fingers, popcorn chicken, wedges, fries and even roasted broccoli, steamed beans or veggie sticks. Or spoon it over a chicken, fish or pork pan fried with just a little salt and pepper.Substitute the mayonnaise with yogurt for a lower fat version. For a brighter yellow colour, use 50/50 dijon and American yellow mustard.
ingredient_lines: 1 - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice
Pinch of salt and white pepper ((sub black))
instruction_lines: Mix the ingredients together, starting with 1 teaspoon of vinegar or lemon juice, then adding the other if you want it a bit tangier. Ready to use!
